hooks.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "master" ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Do not commit directly to main/master. Create a feature branch first.' >&2; exit 1; fi
hooks.description: Branch protection — block commits on main/master

hooks.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "master" ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Do not push directly to main/master. Use a PR.' >&2; exit 1; fi
hooks.description: Branch protection — block pushes on main/master

hooks.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); merged=$(gh pr list --state merged --head "$branch" --json number --jq 'length' 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$merged" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Could not check merged PR status for '$branch'. Verify gh auth and try again." >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ "$merged" -gt 0 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Branch '$branch' already has a merged PR. Create a new branch." >&2; exit 1; fi
hooks.description: Merged branch protection — block pushes to branches with already-merged PRs (fail closed)

hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'git commit'; then LINT_CMD=''; if [ -f engine/package.json ] && grep -q '"lint"' engine/package.json 2>/dev/null; then LINT_CMD='cd engine && bun run lint'; elif [ -f site/package.json ] && grep -q '"lint"' site/package.json 2>/dev/null; then LINT_CMD='cd site && npm run lint'; fi; if [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ]; then echo "Running linter before commit..."; eval $LINT_CMD 2>&1; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Linter failed. Fix lint errors before committing.' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; fi
hooks.description: Linter gate — run linter before any git commit, block if it fails

hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'gh pr create'; then echo 'Running pre-PR checklist...'; PASS=true; LINT_CMD=''; if [ -f engine/package.json ] && grep -q '"lint"' engine/package.json 2>/dev/null; then LINT_CMD='cd engine && bun run lint'; elif [ -f site/package.json ] && grep -q '"lint"' site/package.json 2>/dev/null; then LINT_CMD='cd site && npm run lint'; fi; if [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ]; then eval $LINT_CMD 2>&1 || PASS=false; fi; TEST_CMD=''; if [ -f engine/package.json ] && grep -q '"test"' engine/package.json 2>/dev/null; then TEST_CMD='cd engine && bun test'; fi; if [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ]; then eval $TEST_CMD 2>&1 || PASS=false; fi; grep -rn 'API_KEY=\|SECRET=\|password=\|token=' --include='*.ts' --include='*.js' --include='*.json' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude='*.lock' . 2>/dev/null && echo 'WARNING: Possible hardcoded secrets detected.' && PASS=false; if [ "$PASS" = false ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Pre-PR checks failed. Fix issues before creating PR.' >&2; exit 2; fi; echo 'All pre-PR checks passed.'; fi
hooks.description: Pre-PR gate — run tests, linter, and secret scan before gh pr create

hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '"?[^"]*\.(ts|js|json|astro|md)["\s]?' | head -1 | tr -d '"'); if [ -n "$FILE" ]; then SECRETS=$(grep -nE '(API_KEY|SECRET|TOKEN|PASSWORD|PRIVATE_KEY)\s*[=:]\s*["'\''\`][^"'\''\`]{8,}' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$SECRETS" ]; then echo "⚠ POTENTIAL SECRET DETECTED in $FILE:" >&2; echo "$SECRETS" >&2; echo 'Review immediately — do not commit this file without removing secrets.' >&2; fi; fi
hooks.description: Secret scanner — check for hardcoded secrets after every file write/edit
